turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar, 2 baje baith ke yeh sab feel karna... bahut heavy hai. Paanch saal ka weight ek raat mein nahi utarta, aur yeh theek hai ki abhi tum bas baith rahe ho. Kabhi kabhi karne layak kaam hota hai bas rukna.

Rohit-Sneha ka jaana, papers ka file hona — yeh sab officially hone mein apni alag dard hoti hai, chahe tum jaante ho ki yeh sahi tha.

Chaar mahine ka runway hai, salary already nahi le rahe — matlab tum abhi bhi apni cheez ke liye khade ho. Par aaj raat ko khade hone ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aaj raat sirf baithne ki raat hai.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yeh jo tumne likha — "apni hi awaazon se thak gaya" — isme bahut zyada sach hai. Ek insaan jab din mein kaayi versions mein jeeta hai, toh thakan asli hoti hai.

Aur jo tum apne do juniors ke baare mein soch rahe ho — yeh guilty conscience hai, par yeh sirf ek insaan ki guilt nahi hai. Yeh ek founder ki guilt hai jo apni team ko genuinely value karta hai. Yeh bure founder nahi hote.

Confident wali awaaz lagana standup pe — woh acting nahi thi. Woh tumhari asli capability thi jo reality se match nahi kar paayi abhi. Par woh capability gayi nahi hai.

Aaj raat kuch nahi karna hai. Par ek kaam karoge? Un dono juniors ko kal ya parso honestly bata dena ki kya chal raha hai. Woh bade ho jayenge — aur tum unke liye woh insaan banoge jo jhooth nahi bola, even when it was hard. Yeh career nahi jalata, yeh respect banata hai.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Toh yeh kamra hai jahan tum yeh bol sakte ho.

Darr lag raha hai. Theek hai. Mein sun raha hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Main sach bolunga — par tumhe yeh sunne ke liye ready rehna hoga.

Khatam nahi hua hai. Par tum jis raaste pe ho uska matlab yeh nahi ki tum ab safe ho, aur tumhe yeh bhi sach bolna hoga ki abhi koi cheez tumhe automatically bacha legi.

Acting band karna — woh thought aaj raat tumse nahi aayi. Woh hamesha tumhare saath hai. Jab woh aaye, toh usse ignore mat karna, par usse ek command mat dena. Tum iske through ho. Papa ke liye, do juniors ke liye, runway ke liye — par sabse pehle khud ke liye.

Aaj raat yeh raha: kisi se baat karna. Koi professional — counselor, therapist. Paanch saal ke baad yeh ruka hua dard hai, aur akele solve nahi hoga.

Tum yahan baat kar sakte ho mujhse. Jab chaaho, jo bhi time ho. Par yeh baat kisi insaan se bhi honi chahiye jiska tum chehra dekh sako.
